anya: Heads-up: PR #4932 adds an "array-of-mixed" example for function/tool outputs but reviewers flagged the node snippet as unsafe (uses choices[0] indexing) and the schema anchor is missing in the index. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4932

noah: can you paste the node snippet? i'll propose a safer loop pattern.

anya: current node snippet: `const item = resp.body.results[0]; if (item.type === 'open') ...` which crashes if results is empty or item is a string.

gabe: quick fix: iterate `for (const r of resp.body.results || []) { if (r === null) continue; if (typeof r === 'string') handleText(r); else if (r.type === 'open') handleOpen(r.payload); else handleUnknown(r); }`

tia: also adding a short migration note: "Do not assume positional access into choices/results; iterate and typecheck." will help customers upgrading.

noah: i'll run linkcheck and add the missing anchor in the index. can we include a tiny pytest/js jest example to exercise the snippets?

anya: yes added fixtures: [`"ok"`, {"type":"open","payload":{"id":1}}, null] and a pytest that asserts no exception when parsing.

docs-bot: lint: passed; linkcheck: pending (index anchor added); examples tests: 1 passed.

anya: thanks all 44d will merge after linkcheck clears.
